description: For concrete pour, this estimate request form records pre-pour inspection, batch sequence, placement rate, consolidation, testing, joints, finishing, curing, and protection. use_case: Use the estimate request form during concrete placement readiness and quality record when the concrete pour record must identify placement area, mix design, volume, reinforcement, embeds, forms, access, pump plan, weather, and finish class. Complete the applicable handoff for placed quantity, test sample custody, curing release, deficiency follow-up, finish acceptance, and record archive.
